description: This file contains the implementation of a native MSSQL database driver class and related recordset for PHP within the ADOdb library. It provides methods for connecting to MSSQL, executing queries, handling transactions, fetching database schema info, and other database operations specific to MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB_mssql
classes.description: Driver class providing MSSQL-specific database connection and query execution functionalities.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssql
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from MSSQL database within the ADOdb library.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information such as description and version.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns a SQL expression implementing ISNULL for MSSQL.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Fetches the last inserted identity value using SCOPE_IDENTITY().

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string value for safe SQL inclusion.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table with an initial start value.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates and returns an auto-incremented sequence number.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with a limit and offset.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Constructs a SQL date format string based on the specified format.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table based on a condition.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of available databases.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Returns primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists tables in the database.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Switches the current database context.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Fetches the last error message from MSSQL.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the error number from MSSQL.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MSSQL server.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to MSSQL server.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Establishes a non-persistent connection to MSSQL server.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement with placeholders.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple fields or values into a single string suitable for MSSQL.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Bind a variable as a parameter to a prepared statement or stored procedure.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates BLOB or CLOB data in a table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional parameter binding.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the MSSQL connection.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring SQL expression for MSSQL.
